Local MCP previewSource guide · 2026-11-12

Documentation/Playwright

Playwright

The local browser_read tool renders public pages in a fresh Chromium context and returns bounded text, links and published contacts. It is a narrow read adapter, not the full runner-facing Playwright MCP catalog.

Set up#

Follow Browser setup to build and start local-browser. The pinned dependency comes from the existing packages/playwright lock. Setting an integration flag in the core image does not install a browser.

Authentication and cost#

No vendor API key is needed. The browser does not import your logged-in profiles or cookies. Rendering consumes local CPU and memory; public websites and your host model still receive the data described in Security.

Try it#

text
Use browser_read on this public company page. Report its title, the
relevant project facts and any published contact source URLs.

Boundaries#

Chromium sandboxing stays enabled. Requests are checked against the public-network policy. There are no generic clicking, form, upload or script-evaluation tools. Sites needing a login, CAPTCHA or unsupported interactions may remain unreadable.

Connection test#

Run the container browser smoke test from the implementation's verification instructions. It must launch a real browser and read a controlled fixture. A successful host browser test alone is not evidence for Docker support. See Compatibility.
